info.title: Eligibility & Benefits API
info.description: Answers an Eligibility check for one Member, one Procedure, and one Service date: is the Member's coverage active, what is their Plan's Benefit for the procedure, does it need prior authorization, and what is their cost share. Every Member and Plan is synthetic. The service runs locally and has no authentication.

post.description: One answer for one Member, one procedure, and one Service date, judged as of the Service date rather than today: whether coverage is active, which Plan and plan year the answer comes from, and the Plan's Benefit for the procedure.

200.description: The answer. Coverage that isn't active, and a procedure with no benefit on file, are answers too, not errors.

400.description: The request is malformed: the body isn't a JSON object, a field is missing, the Service date isn't an ISO date, or the procedure code isn't in a CPT or HCPCS format. The detail names the problem. A malformed procedure code is rejected rather than answered as no benefit on file.

500.description: An error the service didn't expect, such as the database being unreachable. The detail is the same for every such error and says nothing about the cause.

get.description: The Plan's details and its Benefits, ordered by procedure code: which procedures the Plan pays for, and on what terms.

500.description: An error the service didn't expect, such as the database being unreachable. The detail is the same for every such error and says nothing about the cause.

get.description: The Member's Coverages, each with its Plan, ordered by start date.

500.description: An error the service didn't expect, such as the database being unreachable. The detail is the same for every such error and says nothing about the cause.

ProblemDetails.description: An error, in the RFC 9457 Problem Details format.

type.description: Identifies the problem type. Left out when it is about:blank, meaning the HTTP status says it all.

title.description: A short summary of the problem type, such as "Not Found".

detail.description: What went wrong with this request.

instance.description: The path of the request that failed.

EligibilityCheckRequest.description: One Member, one procedure, and one Service date.

procedureCode.description: The procedure's code, which must be a CPT code (five digits), a CPT Category II or III code (four digits then F, T, or U), or a HCPCS Level II code (an upper-case letter then four digits). Only the format is checked, not whether the code is in the CPT or HCPCS code sets.

serviceDate.description: The date the procedure is or was performed, as an ISO date. The answer is judged as of this date, past or future.

EligibilityBenefit.description: The Plan's Benefit for the procedure. The terms (priorAuthRequired, deductibleApplies, copay, coinsurancePercent) are set when status is COVERED and null otherwise.

status.description: COVERED: the Plan pays for the procedure. NOT_COVERED: the Plan has a Benefit saying it doesn't. NO_BENEFIT_ON_FILE: the Plan has no Benefit for the procedure, which means unknown, not unpaid, so a person decides. It is not a denial.

priorAuthRequired.description: Whether prior authorization is required before the procedure.

deductibleApplies.description: Whether the deductible applies to the procedure.

copay.description: The copay in dollars, with two decimals.

coinsurancePercent.description: The coinsurance, as a whole-number percentage.

EligibilityCheckResponse.description: The answer to an Eligibility check, judged as of the Service date.

benefit.description: The Plan's Benefit for the procedure. Null when coverage isn't active, so a Benefit the Member can't use is never returned.

EligibilityCoverage.description: Whether the Member has a Coverage active on the Service date and, when they do, which Plan and plan year the answer comes from. Every field but active is null when coverage isn't active.

active.description: Whether the Member has a Coverage active on the Service date.

planYear.description: The calendar year of the Service date.

BenefitSummary.description: A Plan's Benefit for one procedure. When covered is false the Plan excludes the procedure, and the terms (priorAuthRequired, deductibleApplies, copay, coinsurancePercent) are null.

covered.description: Whether the Plan pays for the procedure.

priorAuthRequired.description: Whether prior authorization is required before the procedure.

deductibleApplies.description: Whether the deductible applies to the procedure.

copay.description: The copay in dollars, with two decimals.

coinsurancePercent.description: The coinsurance, as a whole-number percentage.

benefits.description: One Benefit per procedure code. A procedure that isn't listed has no benefit on file under this Plan, which means unknown, not unpaid.
